e.title_hk: FinTech Global（金融科技與保險科技情報）
e.summary: 金融科技情报平台：行业新闻、公司新闻、融资轮次与榜单（InsurTech100 发布方）
e.summary_en: FinTech intelligence platform: industry and company news, funding rounds and rankings (publisher of the InsurTech100)
e.summary_hk: 金融科技情報平台：行業新聞、公司新聞、融資輪次與榜單（InsurTech100 發布方）
e.body: FinTech Global（`fintech.global`）是**面向金融科技与保险科技的情报平台**，栏目按可核实的方式组织：**News（Industry News 行业新闻 / Company News 公司新闻 / Funding Rounds 融资轮次 / Partnerships 合作）**，并设有专门的 **InsurTech** 垂直频道（`fintech.global/insurtech/`）；同时它是 **[[insurtech100]]**（全球百强保险科技榜）的发布方，另有其他金融科技榜单。对 RIAA：它的核心价值不是新闻本身，而是**「融资轮次」这一维度**——保险科技的资本流向是判断哪些细分赛道在升温、哪些公司在扩张的直接信号，也是求职时判断公司健康度的参考；与 [[insurtech100]]（榜单产物）构成「数据 → 排名」的关系，与 [[insurtech-insights]]（社群与会议）构成「情报 → 人脉」的关系；具体公司样本可对照 [[akur8]]、[[tractable]]、[[zestyai]]、[[socotra]]、[[covergo]]、[[shift-technology]]；池内与本条同源的既有词条 [[hybrid-actuarial-role]] 亦出自该站（说明其内容已进入精算职业议题讨论）；适合作行业研究、赛道判断与求职公司调研。
e.body_en: FinTech Global (`fintech.global`) is **an intelligence platform for financial and insurance technology**, organised in a verifiable way: **News (Industry News / Company News / Funding Rounds / Partnerships)** plus a dedicated **InsurTech** vertical (`fintech.global/insurtech/`); it is also the publisher of **[[insurtech100]]** (the annual InsurTech ranking) and of other fintech lists. For RIAA: its value is not the news itself but the **"funding rounds" dimension** — the flow of capital into InsurTech is a direct signal of which sub-sectors are heating up and which companies are expanding, and a reference point for judging company health when job hunting; it stands to [[insurtech100]] (the ranking it produces) as "data → ranking", and to [[insurtech-insights]] (community and conferences) as "intelligence → network"; concrete company samples include [[akur8]], [[tractable]], [[zestyai]], [[socotra]], [[covergo]] and [[shift-technology]]; the corpus’s existing [[hybrid-actuarial-role]] is likewise sourced from this site (evidence that its content has entered actuarial career discussion); suits industry research, sub-sector judgement and company due diligence for applications.
e.body_hk: FinTech Global（`fintech.global`）是**面向金融科技與保險科技的情報平台**，欄目按可核實方式組織：**News（Industry News / Company News / Funding Rounds / Partnerships）**，並設專門的 **InsurTech** 垂直頻道；同時它是 **[[insurtech100]]** 的發布方。對 RIAA：其核心價值不是新聞本身，而是**「融資輪次」這一維度**——保險科技的資本流向是判斷哪些細分賽道在升溫、哪些公司在擴張的直接信號，也是求職時判斷公司健康度的參考；與 [[insurtech100]] 構成「數據 → 排名」，與 [[insurtech-insights]] 構成「情報 → 人脈」；具體公司樣本可對照 [[akur8]]、[[tractable]]、[[zestyai]]、[[socotra]]、[[covergo]]、[[shift-technology]]；池內同源的既有詞條 [[hybrid-actuarial-role]] 亦出自該站；適合作行業研究、賽道判斷與求職公司調研。
